result.summary: The landlord approved the contractor visit for the blocked toilet. A visit was arranged for after 10:30 following Riverside Works' call on 8 Aug, but by 11 Aug there was still no result. I emailed Riverside Works to ask what happened at the visit and placed a 1-day hold to chase. I also flagged a duplicate ticket for the same job (R/PM002-2) to ops at low priority so it can be merged.

judgement.why_this_decision: The job is approved (events 002/003, approval 5) and in works. The visit was arranged (events 009–013), but a system flag on 11 Aug (event 014) shows no outcome recorded. The contractor is the person who can say whether they attended and what they found, so the proportionate step is to ask them and hold for a reply. The duplicate ticket needs an agency decision, so I sent it to ops.

alternatives_considered.why_not: The visit date has passed and the system flagged no result. Waiting longer would let the job stall while the tenant may still have a blocked toilet.

alternatives_considered.option: Escalate the whole case at high priority
alternatives_considered.why_not: There is nothing to suggest an emergency. The contractor can answer the open question.
Riverside Works holds the outcome. One clear ask is better; I'll contact the tenant if the contractor doesn't reply.

alternatives_considered.option: Use the later events on ticket 6
alternatives_considered.why_not: Those events are dated after this case's current point (11 Aug). Using them would mean acting on future information.

result.situation: Blocked toilet: the pan needs removing to clear a run blockage at the pan connector. The landlord approved attendance and Riverside Works was assigned. A visit was arranged for after 10:30 on or about 8 Aug, and by 11 Aug no work result had been recorded.

actions_taken.description: Emailed Riverside Works asking for the visit outcome: completion evidence and invoice, or a quote if more work is needed, or a reason and new date if they didn't attend
actions_taken.result: Sent (message 15); the guard did not block it

actions_taken.description: Hold waiting on the contractor, follow-up in 1 day
Low-priority handover asking ops to merge the duplicate ticket

escalation.reason: A duplicate ticket (R/PM002-2) exists for the same job and needs merging or closing
escalation.handover_summary: Blocked toilet at Flat 3, 15 Willowmere Road. Approved; Riverside Works arranged a visit around 8 Aug but no outcome is recorded. I've chased the contractor and set a 1-day hold. Ticket 6 duplicates this job and uses different tenant/landlord contact records.
escalation.recommendation: Ops to choose a master ticket and merge or close the other, so the contractor and tenant don't get duplicate messages and only one invoice is processed.
